register: Universal Engine / Engineer — Universal Capability Acquisition Register

identity_policy.immutability: candidate_id is immutable and never recycled
identity_policy.allocation: allocate the next unused sequence under a single-writer/PR-serialized process; reserve the number before publishing a record
identity_policy.identity_separation: candidate_id identifies the register record, not a repository URL, package, vendor, release, fork, or implementation
identity_policy.rename_policy: retain candidate_id; append former names to canonical_identity.aliases
identity_policy.fork_policy: register a fork as a distinct candidate with its own ID and forked_from reference
identity_policy.replacement_policy: retain retired candidate and set replaced_by; never transfer its ID
identity_policy.deduplication: compare canonical repository, package coordinates, maintainer and lineage before creating a new record; merge duplicate records only through an auditable redirect, never by reusing an ID

scoring_policy: 0–5 only when evidence exists; null means Unknown, never zero or a favourable assumption
catalogue_state: Initial candidate set; no candidate has been licence-, security-, maintenance-, compatibility- or benchmark-verified by this catalogue
